data.text:
"Create write_correlated_logs.py in the current working directory.
Task: writes application log events that include a shared request or correlation identifier.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: write_correlated_logs.py
+import logging
+import os
+import sys
+import uuid
+
+import requests
+
+
+def _configure_logger() -> logging.Logger:
+    logger = logging.getLogger("correlated_logs")
+    logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
+    handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
+    handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(message)s"))
+    logger.handlers.clear()
+    logger.addHandler(handler)
+    logger.propagate = False
+    return logger
+
+
+def _emit_log(logger: logging.Logger, provider: str, correlation_id: str, event: str, **fields) -> None:
+    payload = {
+        "provider": provider,
+        "correlation_id": correlation_id,
+        "event": event,
+        **fields,
+    }
+    logger.info(payload)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    logger = _configure_logger()
+    correlation_id = os.getenv("CORRELATION_ID", str(uuid.uuid4()))
+    provider = "requests"
+
+    _emit_log(logger, provider, correlation_id, "request_started", method="GET", url="https://httpbin.org/get")
+
+    response = requests.get("https://httpbin.org/get", headers={"X-Correlation-ID": correlation_id}, timeout=10)
+
+    _emit_log(
+        logger,
+        provider,
+        correlation_id,
+        "request_completed",
+        status_code=response.status_code,
+        response_bytes=len(response.content),
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

data.text:
"Create write_structured_log.py in the current working directory.
Task: writes a structured JSON log event to a managed logging service.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: write_structured_log.py
+import json
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+import requests
+
+
+def write_structured_log(event_name: str, severity: str, payload: dict) -> dict:
+    api_key = os.environ["DYNATRACE_API_TOKEN"]
+    environment_id = os.environ["DYNATRACE_ENVIRONMENT_ID"]
+    endpoint = f"https://{environment_id}.live.dynatrace.com/api/v2/logs/ingest"
+    record = {
+        "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        "event_name": event_name,
+        "severity": severity,
+        "payload": payload,
+        "provider": "dynatrace",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        endpoint,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Api-Token {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps([record]),
+        timeout=10,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return record
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    write_structured_log(
+        event_name="structured_log_written",
+        severity="INFO",
+        payload={"status": "ok"},
+    )
*** End Patch
